items.claim: A canvas trial whose view isn't 2D gets no FPS meter because it is gated on zoom
The story finding from B

The duplicate-id error from `mergeContributions` advised "suppress the built-in before adding yours" . That can't work in a trial, because `suppress` applies after the merge, so the same id still collides. It now says to suppress the built-in and give the replacement another id
A's status-bar finding: a status readout without `end` lands at the far end, after the FPS meter (A, overlaps B)
items.note: The status bar now groups its readouts and puts only `end` groups past the spacer. The FPS meter no longer shares the `view` group, so the scale bar stays at the near end.

items.note: Named groups are still announced by their group name; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: An unbound tool still shows its declared key on the rail
items.note: `useSceneToolSlot` reports every tool in the registry, a keyless one as `[]`. `shownKey` treats `[]` as reported and shows no key. The `setToolShortcuts` contract asks a reporter to name every tool, so it only falls back to the declared key for a tool the report leaves out.
